facts.text: Snow left Poison Ridge (6,900 ft) 26 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 and 2024).

evidence.name: Poison Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 29; earlier seasons: June 4 (2023), May 14 (2024); 2025: the sensor kept a reading on bare ground

facts.text: At Poison Ridge (6,900 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.7 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2023, 2024 and 2026).

evidence.name: Poison Ridge
evidence.detail: 1.7 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 74.3 in (2023), 30.1 in (2024)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 10 and May 25, carried from the melt-out dates at Chilkoot Meadow (7,120 ft) and Poison Ridge (6,900 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Chilkoot Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 4, 76 ft above the pass; points to April 11 to May 25

evidence.name: Poison Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 29, 144 ft below the pass; points to April 9 to May 24
